The '''Mis-Tenek system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Planet [[Tenek (planet)|Tenek]] was apparently located in this system.
